verdict.rationale: OpenClaw ships an official `openclaw` CLI with a documented reference covering many subcommands. These include `openclaw mcp serve` and MCP server management, `openclaw skills` (search/install/update/verify/list/info/check/library/workshop), `openclaw security audit`, `openclaw fleet`, and node helpers, and the install docs frame the CLI as the default path. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI experience.
